Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date 14 April

I'm writing to give you an update on the timeline for your project. The certification process for the third-party integration this build depends on has taken longer than the vendor originally indicated, and as a result the project has slipped by two weeks. The revised delivery date is now 14 April.

Our team has been working closely with the vendor to move the certification along and has already completed the surrounding development work, so we can move straight into final integration and testing once certification is confirmed. We do not anticipate any further changes to the schedule and will keep you updated on progress in the meantime.

Does the new delivery date of 14 April still work with your plans on your end? Please let us know if there is anything else you would like us to address before then, and thank you for your continued patience as we bring this project to completion.
